items.t: Kanban Board — Added a resizable height to the Kanban board in App Builder, used as its minimum height at runtime.
Kanban Board — Fixed an issue where a Kanban view filter using a screen control's value showed no cards.
Email monitoring service — Added a 5-second timeout for internal service calls so the email monitoring snapshot fails fast instead of hanging for 100 seconds.
Regression publish tool — Extended the internal regression publish and reset tool to cover app ribbons and app settings in test accounts.
Payment Gateways — Added disclosure of the 0.25% platform fee when connecting a Shuttle payment gateway.
Method Pay — Added a dismiss option to the Method Pay hero banner on the Home page.
Analytics — Added a platform (web/mobile) property to onboarding analytics events.
Analytics — Added AI assistants as a new attribution channel for signup tracking.
Analytics — Added a near-real-time page-view event for the Customers & Leads list to support onboarding analytics.
Opportunities — Fixed an issue where the "Assigned to" filter pill didn't appear after clicking the My Sales Pipeline Home card.
Migration Service — Fixed a database migration that failed on accounts missing an index column, which had blocked later migrations.
App entitlements — Added server-side enforcement so a locked app can't be installed by bypassing the UI.
App lock resolver — Added a shared resolver and visual treatment for locked apps, for upcoming plan-based surfaces.
Gmail Sidebar — Converted the Gmail Addon integration page to TypeScript.
Sign-in — Fixed a bug that sent extra audit-trail entries when revoking access against an unreachable broker.
ms-account-api — Added provider contract verification for Google Calendar sync's account cluster lookup.
oauth2 — Added provider contract verification for Google Calendar sync's token lookup.
Sign-in — Fixed an open-redirect vulnerability in sign-in and consent return-URL handling.
API — Added durable usage telemetry for the REST API, including rate-limit counts and auth method tagging.
API — Fixed an issue where a non-object JSON body on a table create or update request returned a server error instead of a clear error.
API — Fixed an issue where updating only nested child rows without header fields failed with an error.
